name: Neuron Explorer Setup
description: Install and configure neuron-explorer as a long-running systemd service fronted by an nginx /explorer/ location block.  Idempotent.  Designed to be invoked through run-tasks.sh after setup-code-server has produced /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/code-server.

tasks.name: Verify prerequisites (neuron-explorer binary, nginx site, target user)
tasks.description: Hard-fail before mutating state if the host is not ready.
commands: test -x /opt/aws/neuron/bin/neuron-explorer || { echo 'ERROR: /opt/aws/neuron/bin/neuron-explorer missing - update Neuron SDK first'; exit 1; }
test -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/code-server || { echo 'ERROR: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/code-server missing - run code-server-setup first'; exit 1; }
id {{EXPLORER_USER}} >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: user {{EXPLORER_USER}} does not exist'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Install systemd unit, nginx fragment, and start the service
tasks.description: Drops setup-explorer.sh on the instance and runs it.  Re-runnable: the script is idempotent and patches /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/code-server only if the include directive is missing.
commands: echo 'deploy.sh / install-explorer.sh must upload it before this task runs'

tasks.name: Smoke check the service through nginx
tasks.description: Confirm /explorer/ returns the SPA shell and /explorer/api/v1/profiles/search responds.
